scientific_integrity: The independent Poisson limit follows from local mixed factorial moments; remaining disconnectivity is bounded using the cyclic component-envelope decomposition and an explicit near-critical refinement of small-component boundaries. scientific_limitations: The result concerns the critical connectivity probability and two rare-event counts for independent, uniform edge deletion on C_n^3; it does not determine all component sizes, nonuniform edge probabilities or larger fixed bandwidths. Infinite claims use analytic arguments, while the included program tests finite local geometry.
title: Independent Poisson obstructions at the cubic-cycle connectivity window
